_comment: 305-sta GPS deg-15 probe, ONE variable: network.lane_carry.enable false.
WHY.  The LF-1 instrument on _agu305_gps_d15_smoke names the bottleneck exactly:
applyLaneMeasurement 2619071 ms = 84.7 % of the whole run, over 11256 rows,
i.e. 232 ms PER ROW of O(K_c^2) dense downdate at max K_c = 3866.
That is 238 s of dd-build's 265 s/epoch.  basis-project -- the dense W*Pz*W^T I
first suspected -- is 10.8 s total (0.3 %), and every trace sub-block is <0.2 %.
Turning the lane carry off should therefore take a settled 305 epoch from ~310 s
to roughly 50 s.  This is NOT outputs-only: the lane carry feeds the WL bridge, so
the solve changes and the arm needs its own grading.  It is, however, aligned with
the standing MW/WL verdict (mwwl_conditioning_day129: 'do NOT arm; net-harmful')
and the WL-3 card's three falsified mechanisms -- so the question this arm asks is
'does the network give up anything measurable by switching it off?', and the prior
Read the rate from epoch 4 onward: epochs 1-2 run before the DD carry populates.
